opportunities.title: AI Agents Just Popped Their First Solo Zero-Day — Welcome to Autonomous APT
opportunities.why_now: Multiple outlets (Amazon, Register, Hacker News, Dark Reading) are independently confirming the same milestone: a Chinese operation let an AI agent discover and exploit a zero-day in medical imaging software with zero human in the loop.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/analysis stitching the Armory Castle reporting together into one timeline — what the agent actually did, why root access on a university server + medical imaging box matters, and why this is the first confirmed case, not the last

opportunities.title: VMware Knew About Its Critical vCenter Bug in September. You Patched It This Week.
opportunities.why_now: Google just confirmed the 'new' critical VMware vCenter flaw was actively exploited two months before public disclosure, while CISA simultaneously flagged a Cisco Expressway RCE as under active attack.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence timeline post: lay out disclosure date vs. exploitation date vs. patch date, make the lag the headline, close with a 'what to check right now' checklist

opportunities.title: The FBI's Own Crime Database Just Got Hacked — Yes, That One
opportunities.why_now: AP sources confirm an apparent breach of the FBI's key national criminal justice database, a maximum-irony entry for the inevitable-breach file.
opportunities.angle: Short, punchy blog post + X thread on the irony, what's known so far, and why a breach of this particular system (criminal records, warrants) is a different risk class than a retailer breach

opportunities.title: Signal Built a Wall Against AI Agents. Your Phone's OS Is Still Leaving the Door Open.
opportunities.why_now: Signal just shipped code specifically blocking Siri, Gemini, and other AI agents from screenshotting or reading private chats on iOS/Android, right as Dark Reading reports enterprises are scrambling with access-control gaps for AI agents.
opportunities.angle: Contrast piece: Signal's narrow, opinionated fix vs. the broader unsolved problem of OS-level AI agents with screen/clipboard access across every other app — use Signal as the exception that proves the rule

opportunities.title: This Week's Actively-Exploited List: Cisco, VMware, GL.iNet Routers, and an ASP.NET Library Nobody Thought About
opportunities.why_now: CISA added a critical Cisco Expressway RCE to its KEV list the same week as live exploitation reports for VMware vCenter, GL.iNet-managed routers/KVMs, and an ASP.NET anti-CSRF library bug enabling unauthenticated RCE.
opportunities.angle: Rapid-fire 'patch now' digest format — one CVE per line with exploitation status, affected versions, and a single sentence on blast radius; built for the X thread version to drive back to the blog
